Funds for irrigation projects in tribal
areas
†*383. SHRI ABHAY KANT
PRASAD: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the irrigation works in tribal areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the steps taken by Government to
start irrigation related development work in
these areas; and
(e) the amount allocated, State-wise,
particularly to Jharkhand for development
of irrigation projects in the tribal areas?

Allocation of kerosene to Chhattisgarh
and Madhya Pradesh
*381. SHRI RAMADHAR KASHYAP:
Will the Minister  of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether kerosene being allotted to
Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh is in
proportion to the national average;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the quota of kerosene is
proposed to be increased in view of the
increasing population and the dependence
of the rural people on kerosene;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ichampalli and Polavaram irrigation
projects
*382. DR. C. NARAYANA REDDY:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any request from the Government of Andhra
Pradesh to execute major irrigation projects
such as Ichampalli and Polavaram;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to take them up for execution; and

Import of crude oil
†*385. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH  'LALAN':
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the value of import of all the
petroleum and related products during the
last three years, year-wise; and
(b) the percentage of this value out of
the total import value during the said period?
Under-invoicing by exporters/
importers
*386. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Customs authorities have
imposed penalty on several exporters/
importers and individuals for under-
invoicing exports/imports under
COFEPOSA during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
strengthen various laws to check such
frauds; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Nomination on the Board of Directors
of IFCI
†*387. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
SHRIMATI SARLA
MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to nominate Directors from
Ministry of Commerce and Industry and
Reserve Bank of India in-place of private
directors on the Board of Directors of the
Industrial Finance Corporation of India
Limited (IFCI); and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Allocation of gas to power projects
*388. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
DR. A.K. PATEL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the demand for allocation of gas to
power projects at present;
(b) whether Government are considering
the demand;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when Government now propose
to firm up the allocation of gas for Pipavav
Project when the problems between the
British Gas, Reliance, and ONGC
Consortium have been sorted out?
Foreign Exchange options market

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155
625
WIN2\SESSION\2461RS 625
Use of airlines' cargo service by
private courier companies
2853. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether private courier companies
use airlines' cargo service;
(b) whether it is a fact that Indian Post
Office Act does not permit private courier
companies to use the airlines' cargo
service; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?
Operation of small aircrafts
2854. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI JHUMUK LAL
BHENDIA:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to induct small jet engine aircrafts in
Indian Airlines, Alliance Air and Air India
to operate between smaller and less
economical routes like North-Eastern
States and Andaman and Nicobar and
Lakshadweep Islands, etc.;
(b) if so, whether any Committee has
been formed for the purchase of small
aircrafts;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government feel that it
would be feasible and economical to
operate small but good jet engine aircrafts?
Rajkot-Delhi air service
2855. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any demand has been made
to start Rajkot-Delhi flight;
(b) if so, whether Indian Airlines has
started any flight on this route;
(c) the number of passengers who have
travelled by air from Rajkot and Surat to
various parts of the country during the last
three years by Indian Airlines and Jet
Airways;
(d) whether the proposal as mentioned
in (a) above is being implemented; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

626
WIN2\SESSION\2461RS 626
Air India in low cost airlines business
2856. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that premium
airlines around the world are entering the
low cost airlines business by launching no
frill subsidiaries and Air India has decided
to follow suit to retain its passenger
payload; and
(b) if so, what are the details of this
plan and the impact of this degradation of
quality and customer satisfaction on the
airlines business?
APEX fares of AI and IA
2857. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines and Air
India have introduced APEX fares for
various sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof
togetherwith fares on each sector;
(c) whether other private airlines have
also announced similar schemes and their
fares are less as compared to fares of
Indian Airlines/Air India; and
(d) if so, the details of concessional
fares and schemes announced by private
airlines?
Expansion of air services from
Gwalior
†2858. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that flights to
other places in the country are not being
started from Gwalior airport, Madhya
Pradesh despite all facilities and
development of runway there;
(b) if so, what are the impediments due
to which air services are not being started;
and
(c) by when the arrangements for
starting air services from Gwalior are
being planned?
Revival of aerodrome at Cooch Behar,
West Bengal
2859. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
an aerodrome exists in Cooch Behar, West
Bengal which witnessed regular air-
service in the past;
(b) whether Government have received
any proposal seeking revival of the
aerodrome and resuming air service; and
(c) if so, whether Government have
taken initiative in this regard and if so,
the details thereof?
Upgradation of Raipur airport
2860. SHRI JHUMUK LAL
BHENDIA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are any proposal with
Government to upgrade the airport in
Raipur;
(b) if so, by when the said upgradation
work would start and be completed; and
(c) what  funds are involved for the
same?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

627
WIN2\SESSION\2461RS 627
Renovation of Varanasi airport
†2861. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the schemes for the
renovation of Babatpur airport in Varanasi,
U.P. has been sanctioned but the same
have not been started yet; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when these schemes are likely to be
implemented?
Haj traffic
2862. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of the carriers of Haj
traffic during 2000, 2001 and 2002 with
Haj fares as fixed by Government and paid
to the carriers per pilgrim, year-wise;
(b) the prevailing New Delhi-Jeddah-
New Delhi IATA fares
